title: The people hear, but do not act
description: The Lord says to Ezekiel that the people speak about him at the walls and in the doorways, encouraging one another to come and hear the word from the Lord. They sit before him as his people and listen to his words, but do not act on them—with their mouths they show love, but their hearts follow their own gain. To them Ezekiel is like a beautiful love song. But when the word comes true, they will recognize that a prophet has been among them [ref:Esek 33:30-33|Ezekiel 33:30-33].
